business_summary: Sakura Rubber Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells specialty rubber products in Japan. The company offers firefighting products, including fire hoses, firefighting suction hoses, toxic substances measuring instruments, firefighting training and rescue apparatus, advanced rescue apps, air respirators, water rescue tools, air rescue equipment, hydraulic rescue tools, powered impact tools, emergency lifesaving tools, air lifting bags, community disaster prevention apparatus, couplings for large diameter hoses, MVU fans and blowers, and rescue support systems, as well as labor safety equipment. It also provides aerospace products, such as tube assemblies; PTFE and lightweight hoses, dynatube fittings, AM products, machined parts, one hoses, Parker-Stratoflex division products, molded and extruded rubber, silicone and chloroprene rubber ducts, rubber sheets, inflatable rubber seals, thermal insulations, and honeycomb mats. In addition, the company offers industrial rubber products comprising tank vapor seals; oil-resistant hoses for petrochemical plants; suction delivery hoses; gate seals; joints; radar sheets; pressed back products; molded rubber; and insulation hoses for hydroelectric dams and levees, as well as civil engineering-related rubber products and molds for manufacturing rubber products. Further, it engages in the real estate business, such as leasing and operation of shopping malls. Sakura Rubber Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1918 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.
